# Kazakhstan

Values for an OG-Core calibration, then the estimates behind them. How to use them: [calibration guide](../calibration-guide.md).

## Values for OG-Core

| OG-Core input | Wealth gradient | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `fert_gradient` | −0.78, by age as below | MICS 2015, TFR, plus [age offsets](../methods/fertility-by-age.md) |
| `infmort_gradient` | −0.92 | DHS 1999, infant mortality rate |
| `mort_gradient` | — | GDP per capita (PPP, constant 2021 international $) of $37,851 (2025, World Bank) is above the range the [general gradient](../methods/general-gradient.md#scope) is estimated on ($1,100 to $18,000); it is not extrapolated, and the library provides no value |
| `imm_pctiles` | not provided | — |

Divide each value by 100 × (1 − p) before passing it to OG-Core ([how](../calibration-guide.md#converting-a-gradient-to-og-cores-units)).

**`fert_gradient` by age of mother** ([how](../calibration-guide.md#fertility-by-age)):

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| −1.56 | −0.88 | −0.57 | −0.46 | −0.69 | −1.17 | −1.76 |

**`mort_gradient` by age** ([how](../calibration-guide.md#mortality-by-age)):

| 1–4 | 5–14 | 15–29 | 30–44 | 45–59 | 60–74 | 75+ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| −1.55 (DHS 1999) | — | — | — | — | — | 0 |

*Note:* The most recent survey with infant mortality by wealth quintile is from 1999. Gradients can change substantially over such a period; state the survey year when using this value.
